status: Calibration and pitch-transport candidates rejected or bounded diagnostics; soft-pedal transport awaits listening and is not adopted. Frozen research reference remains accepted 0.4.2.
protocol: Quiet-frame candidate compared to accepted0.4.2 on933recordings and1584normal-playing renders. Paired errors use common metric cases andbaseline gain reference. Steinway/Salamander donor experiment uses numeric features only. No sealed observations used. Subsequent body and slow-pole diagnoses use TRAIN only; pitch eligibility reads frozen model outputs. Soft-pedal evaluation reuses all 933 frozen TRAIN/DEV recording caches and two 1584-case soft-on keyboard grids, with no new reference extraction or fitting.

quiet_frame.regeneration_caveat: The paired baseline does not recreate shipping numeric tables. Historical metadata pins generation versions, not the unknown original raw-fit cache runtime. New baseline/candidate share the testedruntime; actualshipping remains acceptance reference. See bounded81-case drift probe.

masked_velocity.decision: Reject fixed full donor curvature; no per-target strength tuning

tail_prior.decision: Reject universal donor residual correction and anti-explosion clamp. Coherent beating makes short local trends unreliable; measurable-future conditioning is not evidence for truly censored orlonger tails.

runtime_diagnosis.status: All research candidates remain out of production. Body survey and slow-pole review are bounded diagnoses; one-window pitch transport is rejected. Soft-pedal transport passes the recorded native/default-sound gates but has full-grid tradeoffs and awaits listening. Reset 0.4.3 is a separate validation underway; no acceptance claim is made here.
runtime_diagnosis.body_observation: TRAIN80 low body modes: loud-layer weighting contaminates soft excitation; independent fixed-pole fit and shared stereo pickup separately lose loud-layer energy. Observed total band is not a proven body-only target.

body_loud_117.scope: Regenerated-baseline trace, TRAIN80v117,150–250Hz,50–300ms aftercontact,originalsourceunits. Not exactshippingheadermeasurement.

runtime_diagnosis.colour_observation: Later independent-lane infinite-energy normalization reintroduces gain steps after coherent50–750ms interpolation. Coherent replacement removes isolated gain steps but shifts anchors and has mixed actual-key/window results.
runtime_diagnosis.noise_observation: Shared random inputs across frequency bands disagree with power-sum density calibration. Independent-band candidate matches native stochastic predictions but fails existing chord-headroom margin.

all_regressions.meaning: Positive changes are worse reference-score errors. Note regressions are paired across shared observations; individual cases are also retained without selection.

noise_rise_seed_audit.note: Eight-seed finite sample, paired seeds do not mean identical noise realizations after differing draw scheduling; no inference of a universal seed distribution or perception threshold.

anchor_preserving_colour.limitations: Pure measured builds only; external harness prepares exact native endpoint ratios. Mixed builds/realtime cache architecture unresolved. No full recording/keyboard benchmark or production change.
anchor_preserving_colour.status: Bounded only; phase/stereo/window tradeoffs remain. Not adopted.

runtime_diagnosis.body_conditional_constraint: Observed totalbandpower is a conditionalobservationalbound, not identifiedbody-onlyenergy orstatisticalconfidence; noDEVgainused.
runtime_diagnosis.production_engine_sha256_scope: Frozen accepted 0.4.2 source used for these experiments, not an assertion about the current working-tree reset candidate.

body_train_panel.decision: Do not generalize the Kawai80 repair or add global body gains from this panel. Retain the existing mechanism-specific Kawai80 evidence; any broader body-table change needs per-anchor observability and export-stage diagnosis in original TRAIN units.
body_train_panel.selection: Each of six models: TRAIN pitch nearest MIDI 72 and 84, lower-pitch ties; all recorded TRAIN layers.
body_train_panel.measurement: Native struck body versus recorded total, 150-250 Hz band over 50-300 ms after existing contact; known gain/outputScale inversion only.
limits: Bounded selected panel, not a random all-keyboard sample or fit acceptance test.
Recorded total band is not an identified body-only target; coherent interference prevents a hard calibration inequality.
Quietest complete one-second tail window is selection-biased, not measured noise or statistical confidence; no subtraction.
Source-level units do not undo DC blocking, radiation or the rest of the native signal path. No DEV/sealed reads or fits.

slow_pole_proposal.decision: Do not treat a minimum-rate pole lock as protection of the observed note-86 tail. No optimizer or new coefficient fit run.
slow_pole_proposal.cross_note_rationale: 82 already retains its slowest pole; 84 improves average native late errors with an alternative basis despite replacing its slowest. No universal one-pole identification claim follows.
limits: Individual pole power and fixed-coefficient omission are conditional model diagnostics, not isolated measured modes or nested-fit significance.
A fixed pole can receive zero excitation or be coherently cancelled. The 0.003/s fitter boundary is not a confidence interval.
Before any new search, predeclare full-coherent late-response retention across all 15 supported TRAIN cases and native export; no coefficient floor, new loss weight or per-case winner.

whole_pattern_pitch_transport.decision: Reject the unconstrained one-window real-Hilbert spherical construction; no broad recording evaluation, listening, production mask or new fit.
limits: Nine deliberately difficult intervals, one selected layer each, and stored pitch coordinates do not certify whole intervals or velocity coverage.
The screen uses endpoint ranges expanded to baseline, with strict numeric comparisons; it is an artifact guard, not an acoustic law or audibility bound.
A different hypothetical gain per partial overestimates feasibility; no common colour-gain closure or masked native engine was evaluated.
Pure zero-channel representation does not safely traverse current mixed-piano metadata. Soft ranks, mixed builds, numerical interval certification and tail observability remain unresolved.
Power diagnostics sum slots; later windows omit cross-slot interference, body/noise/halo and output processing. They are not complete-output dBFS or reference agreement.

soft_pedal_lane_transport.decision: Pending listening; not adopted. Mechanism correction and default-sound identity do not establish soft-pedal acoustic improvement.
soft_pedal_lane_transport.mechanism: Carry existing -0.28/0/0/+0.08 bias with canonical measured-anchor paired lanes instead of assigning by current decay rank; measured coefficients and poles unchanged.

keyboard.fresh_engine_repeat_scope: First keyboard case in each build only; every case receives finite/half-gain checks.

soft_pedal_lane_transport.rise_interpretation: All three retain the same event onset. New York and Kawai chiefly switch the 90% crossing between peaks; Belmont also changes early RMS shape materially. Not a soft-pedal recording-error comparison.

cpu.scope: Serial Apple M1 Max development-machine native runs; not Reason/DAW performance or a deadline guarantee.

limits: Pure-piano soft-on keyboard only; mixed-string builds still pair by rank.
Selected crossing contraction is a numerical regression test, not a whole-domain or audibility certificate.
